user.title: Sungrow Energy Manager settings
user.description: Choose Sungrow entities for Grid Target export control, optional Morning Discharge, and Night Tariff scene switching. Morning Discharge requires all four related entities; Night Tariff requires the no-discharge scene.

data.scene_entity: Self-Consumption Mode (max battery discharge) — normal scene
data.reserve_soc_entity: Battery Reserved SoC for Backup entity (%)
data.discount_scene_entity: Night tariff — no battery discharge scene

data_description.export_entity: Live power being exported to the grid, in watts. Grid Target uses this value to decide when to change the battery charging limit.
data_description.charge_entity: Writable number entity that sets the battery charging power limit, in watts. Grid Target adjusts it in steps after the configured delay.
data_description.scene_entity: Activate Self-Consumption Mode (max battery discharge) when starting Grid Target, when Morning Discharge ends outside the discount, and when Night Tariff is outside discounted hours.
data_description.soc_entity: Current battery charge percentage. Morning discharge starts only when SOC is above the configured Empty SOC threshold and backup reserve.
data_description.reserve_soc_entity: Actual Sungrow Battery Reserved SoC for Backup value. The controller stops forced discharge when the battery reaches this percentage.
data_description.forced_scene_entity: Scene that puts the inverter into Battery Forced Discharge mode. Only used by the optional morning discharge schedule.
data_description.forced_power_entity: Writable number entity for Battery forced charge discharge power. The controller sets this value before activating the forced discharge scene.
data_description.discount_scene_entity: Select Self-Consumption Mode (no battery discharge). This scene is activated during configured discounted night hours; verify it really prevents battery discharge. The normal scene is used outside the discount.

remove.title: Remove Sungrow Energy Manager
remove.description: An existing Sungrow Energy Manager configuration entry was found, even if it is hidden from the integration list. Confirm removal of the entry and its entities. Other integrations will not be affected.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Sungrow Energy Manager is already installed.
abort.removed_successfully: Sungrow Energy Manager entry removed. You can uninstall its files through HACS.

error.charge_range: Invalid charge control range: max must be greater than min
